title: Delivery & Shipping Policy
intro: Everything we sell is digital or a service, so nothing is shipped physically. This page explains how and when you receive what you buy. All prices are in Egyptian Pounds (EGP).

sections.title: 1. No Physical Shipping
sections.content: We do not sell physical products, so there are no shipping fees, no shipping addresses and no delivery times for parcels.

sections.title: 2. Notion Templates
content: Templates are delivered instantly after payment.
If you buy through Notion, you receive access from your Notion purchases right after checkout.
If you buy from us directly, you receive the template link by email, or on your account, right after payment.

sections.title: 3. The Notion Course
content: Access to the course is activated on your account right after payment, usually within minutes.
The course opens inside the MY Hub app for Windows (available from the Microsoft Store). Sign in with the same email you bought with, and the course appears under My courses.
If you paid and still cannot access the course after 24 hours, contact us and we will fix it.

sections.title: 4. Custom Services and Monthly Support
content: Services are delivered according to the schedule and milestones in your written proposal.
Monthly support starts on the date agreed with you and renews monthly; replies follow the response times on the Services page.
Deliverables are shared digitally: Notion pages, video walkthroughs and documents.

sections.title: 5. Delivery Problems
content: Check your spam folder and the email you used at checkout.
If you did not receive what you paid for, email us with your order details and we will resend it or fix the access, usually within 2 business days.
